title: Pre-Semisimple Character Datum In The Theta Draft
body_html:
Pre-Semisimple Character Datum In The Theta Draft

The current theta draft starts with a datum

$$ \Sigma=(V,\beta,\phi) $$

called a pre-semisimple character datum for the unitary group $G=U(V)$. The TeX uses:

  • a semisimple element $\beta$;
  • a character datum $\phi$;
  • the centralizer

$$ G^0=\operatorname{Cent}_G(\beta); $$

  • for a point $x\in B(G^0)$, an isotypic datum or representation denoted $\phi_{\Sigma,x}$.

The draft decomposes

$$ \beta=\bigoplus_i\beta_i, \qquad V=\bigoplus_i V_i, \qquad \Sigma=\bigoplus_i\Sigma_i. $$

It also writes

$$ G^0={}^+G^0\times Z_G $$

where $Z_G$ is the depth-zero block.

Draft Caution

Part III does not yet give a standalone formal definition of all allowed triples $(V,\beta,\phi)$ or the construction of $\phi_{\Sigma,x}$. This node records the data explicitly used by the theta draft.
